elections.note: CED 2025 is the ABS approximation of the federal divisions in force at the 2025 federal election, including the Northern Territory redistribution determined on 4 March 2025.

No redistribution has been determined since the 2025 election in NSW, Victoria, Queensland, WA or the NT (AEC redistributions page, checked 2026-10-12), so CED 2025 matches the boundaries for the next election there. South Australia, Tasmania and the ACT were redistributed on 2026-10-08 and no ABS correspondence for the new divisions exists yet, so any postcode that falls in a division of those states is not published for the next election.

sources.title: ABS Census of Population and Housing: Mesh Block Counts, 2021
sources.note: Usual-resident persons per 2021 Mesh Block, used to weight the CED 2025 membership of the postcodes containing a changed mesh block.

method: Each postcode lists every CED 2025 division it falls in. A division holding a share below the ABS minimum output size (BMOS_NULL_FLAG 1, a share below 0.01) is listed separately as one a small part may fall in. Population shares are not published. For postcodes 0830 and 0832, which contain mesh blocks moved by the 2025 Northern Territory redistribution, each division's share is the Census 2021 persons in the postal area's mesh blocks allocated to it in CED 2025, over the postal area's total; a share of 0.01 or more lists the division, a smaller non-zero share lists it as a small part, and an unpopulated share is left out. No AEC boundary geometry is used. Reproduce with: node scripts/build-postcode-electorates.mjs <folder holding the six files> --check (the correspondence xlsx is extracted from the archive).
